values.value: Not blank:Keep the kept person's value, and fill only its blanks;Keep master:Keep the kept person's value, even a blank;Most recent:Take the value of the person changed last;Oldest record:Take the value of the person created first;Most complete:Take the longer value

When auto-merge merges two people, which value each field keeps when it has no merge rule of its own. Per-field rules are on the Custom Metadata page under Merge Rules. Except under Keep master, a blank never replaces a value. The household and the record owner always stay the kept person's.
